item.title: Banks Likely to Follow KB’s Lead in Slashing Mortgage Loans to 300 Million Won… Tightening the Reins Amid Real Estate Market Volatility (은행들, KB ‘주담대 3억으로 축소’ 따라할 듯…부동산 들썩여 ‘고삐’)
item.description:
Following KB Kookmin Bank’s surprise announcement that it will drastically reduce the maximum limit for home purchase-purpose mortgage loans from 600 million won to 300 million won starting on the 10th, other commercial banks are also reportedly considering similar loan limit reductions. Amid continuing instability in the real estate market, particularly in the southern Gyeonggi region, a wave of stringent measures aimed at managing household loans is expected to unfold simultaneously. (케이비(KB)국민은행이 오는 10일부터 주택구입목적 주택담보대출 최대한도를 현행 6억원에서 3억원으로 대폭 축소한다고 기습 발표한 가운데, 다른 시중은행들도 대출한도 축소 조처를 검토하고 있는 것으로 나타났다. 최근 경기 남부권을 중심으로 부동산 시장의 불안이 이어지는 가운데, 가계대출 관리를 위한 고강도 조처가 동시다발로 이어질 것으로 보인다.)

Shinhan Bank announced on the 9th that it would restrict the subscription of mortgage insurance (MCI/MCG) starting on the 10th in order to strengthen household loan volume management. Limiting the subscription of mortgage insurance, which is often taken out alongside mortgage loans, effectively reduces the loan limit. This insurance product allows borrowers to receive up to the maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratio by having a guarantee institution step in to cover a certain percentage of the housing price—specifically, the small-sum tenant deposit (bangongje) is not excluded. Among the top five commercial banks, KB Kookmin Bank, Hana Bank, and NH Nonghyup have largely restricted new subscriptions for mortgage insurance since late May to manage household debt. (신한은행은 9일 가계대출 총량 관리 강화를 위해 오는 10일부터 모기지 보험(MCI·MCG) 가입을 제한한다고 밝혔다. 주담대와 함께 가입하는 모기지 보험 가입을 제한하면, 대출 한도가 줄어드는 효과가 있다. 이 보험은 주택담보대출 실행 때 주택 가격의 일정 비율에 해당하는 소액임차보증금(방공제)을 제외하지 않고, 대출 한도를 담보인정비율(LTV) 최대치까지 모두 받을 수 있도록 보증기관이 대신 보증해 주는 상품이다. 5대 시중은행 가운데 KB국민은행, 하나은행, 엔에이치(NH)농협 등은 지난 5월 말부터 가계부채 관리를 위해 모기지 보험 신규 가입을 대부분 제한하고 있다.)

The banking sector has been tightening household loans across the board. KB Kookmin Bank announced the previous day that starting on the 10th, it will reduce the mortgage loan limit from a maximum of 600 million won to 300 million won, covering not only the Seoul metropolitan area and regulated regions but also unregulated areas. The Financial Services Commission had limited home purchase-purpose mortgage loans in the capital area and regulated regions to 600 million won since the end of June last year, but this time, a commercial bank has voluntarily slashed the limit even further. New loan applications through loan broker channels are also being halted one after another. (은행권은 최근 전방위로 가계대출을 조이고 있다. KB국민은행은 10일부터 수도권·규제지역뿐 아니라 비규제지역까지 포함해 주택담보대출 한도를 최대 6억원에서 3억원으로 축소하기로 했다고 전날 발표했다. 금융위원회는 지난해 6월 말부터 수도권·규제지역의 주택구입목적 주담대 한도를 6억원으로 제한해 왔는데 이 한도를 시중은행이 자체적으로 대폭 축소한 것이다. 대출모집인 채널을 통한 신규 대출 접수도 속속 중단되고 있다.)

A commercial bank official stated, "Given the bank-by-bank regulations, such as KB Kookmin Bank's reduction in loan limits, there could be a temporary shift in loan demand to other banks," adding, "In light of this, it's possible that high-intensity measures will emerge simultaneously across the banking sector for the time being." This suggests that other commercial banks are likely to follow suit with concerted reductions in mortgage loan limits. (시중은행 관계자는 “케이비국민은행의 대출한도 축소 등 은행별 규제에 따라 다른 은행으로 대출 수요가 일시적으로 쏠리는 현상이 나타날 수 있다“며 “이를 고려해 당분간 고강도 조치가 은행권에서 동시다발로 나올 가능성이 있다”고 말했다. 조만간 다른 시중은행들도 일제히 주담대 한도 축소 조치에 나설 거라는 얘기다.)

Indeed, as asset markets such as real estate and stocks have recently heated up, household loans have shifted to a significant upward trend. According to the Bank of Korea's "June Financial Market Trends" statistics released on the same day, the balance of bank household loans at the end of June stood at 1,189.4 trillion won, an increase of 7.6 trillion won from the previous month. This is the largest increase since August 2024 (9.2 trillion won). Mortgage loans grew by 4.3 trillion won due to an increase in housing transactions in the capital area and demand for interim payments for new housing supply, while other loans—primarily credit loans—rose by 3.3 trillion won amid expanded stock investments. (실제 최근 부동산과 주식 등 자산시장이 들썩이면서 가계대출은 큰 폭의 증가세로 돌아선 상황이다. 한국은행이 이날 내놓은 ‘6월 금융시장 동향’ 통계를 보면 6월 말 기준 은행 가계대출 잔액은 1189조4천억원으로, 전월에 견줘 7조6천억원 증가했다. 2024년 8월(9조2천억원) 이후 최대 증가 폭이다. 주담대는 수도권 주택거래량 증가, 분양 물량의 중도금 납부 수요로 4조3천억원 늘었고, 주식투자 확대 영향으로 신용대출을 중심으로 기타대출도 3조3천억원 증가했다.)

Shin Jin-chang, Director of the Financial Services Commission's Office of Policy Coordination, held a "Joint Household Debt Inspection Meeting" at the government Seoul office on the same day and urged the financial sector to "strengthen household loan management," stating, "Considering that mortgage loans are typically executed with a time lag of 2 to 3 months after a housing sale contract is signed, there is a possibility that the impact of increased transaction volumes prior to the end of the heavy capital gains tax grace period (May 9) will be reflected in mortgage loans for some time." Regarding high-value in-house loans (company loans to employees), which have recently been criticized as a loophole for evading household loan regulations, Director Shin also requested voluntary regulation from companies. He said, "While it's difficult to directly apply household loan regulations to in-house loans, since such loans could amplify instability in the housing market, I hope to see voluntary efforts by companies spread, such as setting up first-priority mortgages, requiring principal and interest installment repayment, restricting loans for multiple homeowners, limiting high-value homes, and limiting housing size." (신진창 금융위원회 사무처장은 이날 정부서울청사에서 ‘가계부채 합동점검 회의’를 열어 “통상 주택 매매계약 후 2∼3개월의 시차를 두고 주택담보대출이 실행되는 점을 감안할 때 양도소득세 중과 유예 종료(5월9일) 이전에 확대된 거래량의 영향이 당분간 주담대에 반영될 가능성이 있다”며 “가계대출 관리를 강화해달라”고 금융권에 당부했다. 최근 가계대출 규제의 회피 통로가 된다고 지적받는 고액 사내대출과 관련해서도 신 사무처장은 기업에 자율 규제를 요청했다. 그는 “사내대출에 가계대출 규제를 직접 적용하는 것은 어렵지만 사내대출이 주택시장의 불안을 확대할 수 있는 만큼 1순위 근저당권 설정, 원리금 분할상환, 다주택자 취급 제한, 고가 주택 제한, 주택 면적 제한 등 기업들의 자율 관리 노력이 확산되기를 기대한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Sahmyook University Signs MOU for Academic Exchange with the University of Florence (삼육대, 伊 피렌체대와 학술교류 MOU)
item.description:
Sahmyook University (President Jae Jong Je) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) for cultural and academic exchange with the University of Florence in Italy. (삼육대(총장 제해종)는 이탈리아 피렌체대학교(University of Florence)와 문화 및 학술교류를 위한 업무협약(MOU)을 체결했다.)

The signing ceremony was held on June 17 at the University of Florence, attended by Sahmyook University President Jae Jong Je, Director of International Affairs Joon Beom Park, and University of Florence Chancellor Alessandra Petrucci, among others. (협약식은 지난 6월 17일 피렌체대에서 열렸으며, 삼육대 제해종 총장과 박준범 국제처장, 피렌체대 알레산드라 페트루치(Alessandra Petrucci) 총장 등이 참석했다.)

Founded in 1321, the University of Florence is a prominent national comprehensive university in Italy with over 50,000 students. It has produced numerous notable figures, including former Italian Prime Minister Matteo Renzi, and is a research-oriented university ranked among the top in major global university evaluations. (1321년에 기원을 둔 피렌체대는 5만명 이상의 학생이 재학 중인 이탈리아의 대표적인 국립 종합대학이다. 마테오 렌치(Matteo Renzi) 전 이탈리아 총리 등 다수의 저명인사를 배출했으며, 글로벌 주요 대학 평가에서 상위권에 랭크된 연구 중심 대학이다.)

This agreement focuses on substantive academic exchange between the two universities. The key area of cooperation is "Applied Psychology and Well-being for Sustainable Development." Sahmyook University's Department of Counseling Psychology and the University of Florence's Department FORLILPSI (Education, Languages, Intercultural Studies, Literature, and Psychology) will lead the collaborative programs. (이번 협약은 양 대학 간의 실질적인 학술교류에 초점이 맞춰졌다. 핵심 교류 분야는 ‘지속 가능한 발전을 위한 응용 심리학 및 웰빙(Applied Psychology and Well-being for Sustainable Development)’이다. 삼육대 상담심리학과와 피렌체대 FORLILPSI(교육·언어·상호문화·문학·심리학) 학과가 주축이 돼 협력 프로그램을 운영한다.)

The two universities will carry out: △reciprocal visits by professors and researchers, △joint research projects, △academic seminars and conferences, and △exchange of publications and academic information. (양 대학은 △교수 및 연구원 상호 파견 △공동 연구 프로젝트 수행 △학술 세미나 및 컨퍼런스 개최 △출판물 및 학술정보 교환 등을 진행한다.)

Student exchanges will also be promoted. Students sent abroad will receive tuition waivers from the host university and will have access to educational facilities and tutoring services at the respective institution. (학생 교류도 추진한다. 파견 학생에게는 초청 대학의 등록금 면제 혜택이 제공되며, 해당 기관의 교육 시설과 튜터링 서비스를 지원받는다.)

Additionally, they have agreed to operate a co-supervised (Cotutelle) double PhD program, laying the groundwork for training research personnel. The practical coordination of this program will be managed by Professor Kyung Hyun Seo of Sahmyook University's Department of Counseling Psychology and Professor Annamaria Di Fabio of the University of Florence. (이 외에도 공동 지도(Cotutelle) 방식의 복수 박사학위(Double PhD) 과정 운영에 합의해 연구 인력 양성을 위한 기반을 마련했다. 해당 프로그램의 실무 총괄은 삼육대 상담심리학과 서경현 교수와 피렌체대 안나마리아 디 파비오(Annamaria Di Fabio) 교수가 맡는다.)

Sahmyook University President Jae Jong Je stated, "It is significant to bring together the spirit of academic exchange with the University of Florence, which has a long history and academic tradition. Starting with this agreement, we will pursue practical research cooperation and personnel exchanges between the two universities in various fields, including applied psychology and well-being." (삼육대 제해종 총장은 “오랜 역사와 학문적 전통을 지닌 피렌체대와 학술교류의 뜻을 모으게 돼 의미가 깊다”며 “이번 협약을 기점으로 응용 심리학 및 웰빙 분야를 비롯한 다양한 영역에서 양 대학의 실질적인 연구 협력과 인적 교류를 추진할 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Exchange rate back above 1,500 won within a day… Bank of Korea governor "Room for won strength" (환율 하루 만에 다시 1500원 위로…한은 총재 “원화 강세 여지 있어”)
item.description:
The won-dollar exchange rate's volatile trend continues, crossing the 1,500 won mark again within a day. (미 달러화에 대한 원화 환율의 불안정한 흐름이 이어지며 하루 만에 다시 1500원 선을 넘었다.)

On the 9th, in the Seoul foreign exchange market, the won-dollar exchange rate closed daytime trading at 1,506.1 won, up 7.6 won from the previous day. The previous day's daytime closing rate was 1,498.5 won, which had fallen below 1,500 won for the first time since May 14 (1,491.0 won). On this day, the exchange rate started trading at 1,507.5 won, up 9.0 won from the previous day, and fluctuated repeatedly. It rose to as high as 1,509.0 won during the session before reversing to drop as low as 1,496.8 won. (9일 서울 외환시장에서 원-달러 환율은 전날보다 7.6원 오른 1506.1원에 주간거래를 마쳤다. 전날 주간거래 종가 환율은 1498.5원으로 5월14일(1491.0원) 이후 처음 1500원 아래로 떨어졌던 터였다. 이날 환율은 전날보다 9.0원 오른 1507.5원에 거래를 시작한 뒤 등락을 거듭했다. 장중 한때 1509.0원까지 올랐다가 하락 반전해 1496.8원까지 떨어지기도 했다.)

Renewed tensions between the U.S. and Iran, along with the release of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) minutes highlighting the possibility of a U.S. base rate hike, are dampening expectations for the won-dollar exchange rate to settle in the 1,400 won range. The June FOMC minutes released this day confirmed that participants assessed that "concerns about the labor market have eased somewhat, but inflation concerns are growing." (미국과 이란 간 긴장이 재차 고조되고, 연방공개시장위원회(FOMC) 의사록 공개로 미국의 기준금리 인상 가능성이 다시 부각돼 원-달러 환율 1400원대 안착에 대한 기대감을 떨어뜨리고 있다. 이날 공개된 6월 연방공개시장위원회 의사록에는 참석자들이 “노동 시장에 대한 우려는 다소 완화됐지만 인플레이션 우려는 커지고 있다”고 평가한 것으로 확인됐다.)

Reports that foreign exchange authorities in South Korea and Japan are cooperating for market stability, and expectations fueled by SK Hynix's imminent American Depositary Receipt (ADR) issuance (listing on Nasdaq), limited the upward movement, with the rate largely fluctuating in the early 1,500 won range. (한국과 일본의 외환당국 간 시장 안정을 위해 공조하고 있다는 전언, 에스케이(SK)하이닉스의 미국주식예탁증서(ADR) 발행(나스닥 상장) 임박에 따른 기대감으로 상승 폭은 제한돼 주로 1500원대 초반에서 움직이는 모습이다.)

Bank of Korea Governor Shin Hyun-song stated during a question-and-answer session at the National Assembly's Strategy and Finance Committee plenary meeting, "Current account surpluses are accumulating significantly," and "there is considerable room for the won to shift to strength (exchange rate decline) in the future." (신현송 한국은행 총재는 이날 국회 재정경제위원회의 전체회의 질의·응답 과정에서 “경상수지 흑자가 큰 폭으로 누적되고 있다”며 “앞으로 원화가 강세(환율 하락)로 돌아설 여지가 상당히 있다”고 말했다.)

Regarding the recent rise in the exchange rate, Governor Shin added, "The dollar is strong due to the possibility of changes in U.S. monetary policy (rate hikes)," and "domestically, there are also factors like (foreign investors') portfolio rebalancing. While short-term supply and demand are important determining factors, I believe there are also fundamental values in the long term." This is interpreted as implying that the current exchange rate rise is excessive in light of the won's fundamental value, considering factors such as the current account surplus. (신 총재는 최근의 환율 상승에 대해 “미국 통화정책의 변화(금리 인상) 가능성 때문에 달러가 강세”라며 “국내에서는 (외국인 투자자의) 포트폴리오 리밸런싱(재조정) 요인도 있다. 단기적으로 수급이 중요한 결정 요인이지만, 장기적으로 기초가치도 있다고 생각한다”고 덧붙였다. 경상수지 흑자 등을 고려한 원화의 기초가치에 비춰 현재 환율 상승은 과도하다는 뜻을 비친 것으로 풀이된다.)

Regarding the net selling of domestic stocks by foreign investors, which is cited as a major factor in the won-dollar exchange rate rise, Governor Shin said, "Since Korean stock prices have risen significantly, foreigners are continuing to sell as they reduce their weight," adding, "I think (the foreign selling trend) will ease somewhat in the second half of this year." (원-달러 환율 상승의 주요인으로 꼽히는 외국인 투자자들의 국내 주식 순매도세에 대해 신 총재는 “한국 주식 가격이 많이 올라 외국인들이 비중을 줄이는 과정에서 매도세를 이어가고 있다”며 “올해 후반기에는 (외국인 매도세가) 좀 잦아들 것으로 생각한다”고 말했다.)

Senior Correspondent Kim Young-bae kimyb@hani.co.kr (김영배 선임기자 kimyb@hani.co.kr)

item.title: ‘Grok 4.5’ Released…Musk Claims “Opus-Class, Faster and Cheaper” (‘그록 4.5’ 출시…머스크 “오퍼스급에 더 빠르고 저렴” 주장)
item.description:
xAI, the artificial intelligence development division of SpaceX—led by Tesla CEO Elon Musk—has launched the ‘Grok 4.5’ AI model, co-developed with coding company Cursor. (테슬라 최고경영자(CEO) 일론 머스크가 이끄는 인공지능·우주기업 스페이스엑스(X)의 인공지능 개발 사업부 엑스에이아이(xAI)가 코딩기업 커서와 공동 개발한 인공지능 모델 ‘그록 4.5’를 출시했다.)

SpaceX AI officially announced the release of Grok 4.5 on the 8th (local time), highlighting its strengths in coding, agent tasks, and knowledge work. The company explained that the model’s training utilized tens of thousands of NVIDIA’s latest GB300 graphics processing units and that quality assessment processes were strengthened to improve data quality. (스페이스엑스에이아이는 8일(현지시각) 코딩과 에이전트(비서) 작업, 지식 작업에 강점을 가진 그록 4.5를 공식 출시한다고 발표했다. 회사는 해당 모델 학습에 엔비디아의 최신 그래픽처리장치 지비(GB)300 수만장을 활용했고, 데이터 품질을 높이기 위해 품질 평가 과정을 강화했다고 설명했다.)

According to their disclosed benchmarks, in metrics evaluating coding ability in terminal environments, Grok 4.5 scored lower than OpenAI’s ChatGPT-5.5 model but higher than Claude’s Opus 4.8 model. In metrics measuring coding performance for Java and Python, it scored higher than the GPT-5.5 model but lower than Opus 4.8. The usage cost of Grok 4.5 is $2 to $6 per million tokens, making it two to four times cheaper than the Opus 4.8 model ($5 to $25). Elon Musk emphasized on X (formerly Twitter) that day, calling Grok 4.5 “an Opus-class model but faster, more token-efficient, and cheaper.” (이들이 공개한 벤치마크(성능지표)를 보면, 터미널 환경에서 코딩능력을 평가하는 지표에선 오픈에이아이(AI)의 챗 지피티-5.5 모델보다는 낮고, 클로드의 오퍼스 4.8 모델보다는 높은 점수를 얻었다. 자바·파이선 등의 코딩 성능을 측정하는 지표에선 지피티-5.5 모델보다는 점수가 높고 오퍼스 4.8보다는 낮았다. 그록4.5의 이용 가격은 100만 토큰당 2~6달러로, 오퍼스 4.8 모델(5~25달러)보다 2~4배 이상 저렴하다. 일론 머스크는 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 그록4.5를 두고 “오퍼스급 모델이지만 더 빠르고, 토큰 효율이 높고 비용이 더 저렴하다”고 강조했다.)

SpaceX acquired xAI, the AI startup led by Musk, in February and subsequently rebranded the external brand as ‘SpaceX AI.’ Last month, SpaceX announced it would acquire Anysphere, the operator of the AI coding tool Cursor, in a $60 billion all-stock transaction, and has since been developing Grok jointly with the Cursor development team. (스페이스엑스는 지난 2월 머스크가 이끄는 인공지능 스타트업 엑스에이아이를 인수했고, 이후 대외 브랜드를 ‘스페이스엑스에이아이’로 리브랜딩 했다. 이후 스페이스엑스는 지난달엔 인공지능 코딩도구인 커서의 운영사 애니스피어를 600억달러 규모의 전액 주식 거래로 인수하겠다고 발표한 뒤 커서 개발팀과 공동으로 그록 개발을 진행해왔다.)

By Kang Jae-gu j9@hani.co.kr (강재구 기자 j9@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Rest Area Operations Amid 'Ex-Korea Expressway Corporation Employee Cartel Controversy' to Be Handled by Public Management Company (‘도공 퇴직자 카르텔 논란’ 휴게소 운영, 공공관리회사가 맡는다)
item.description:
The operation of highway rest areas, which had sparked controversy over a 'Korea Expressway Corporation (KEC) retiree cartel,' will be transitioned to a public management system. Retiree groups of KEC will be expelled from rest area operations, and families of current and former KEC employees will also be excluded from bidding on in-store concessions. (‘한국도로공사 퇴직자 카르텔’ 논란이 일었던 고속도로 휴게소 운영 방식이 공공관리 체제로 전환된다. 도공 퇴직자 단체는 휴게소 운영에서 퇴출하고, 도공 전·현직 직원 가족은 입점 매장 입찰에서도 배제하기로 했다.)

The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport announced on the 9th that it will reorganize the highway rest area operation system by having a newly established public management company directly contract with concessionaires. Previously, rest area operations involved a multi-tiered structure of 'KEC - intermediate operator - concessionaire,' but the plan simplifies this by setting up a specialized public management company to directly handle bidding and contracts for rest area concessionaires. (국토교통부는 새로 설립되는 공공관리 회사가 입점업체와 직접 계약하는 방식으로 고속도로 휴게소 운영 체계를 개편한다고 9일 밝혔다. 그동안 휴게소 운영은 ‘도공-중간운영업체-입점업체’로 이어지는 다단계 구조로 이뤄졌는데, 전문적인 공공관리 회사를 세워서 휴게소 입점업체 입찰 및 계약을 직접 진행하는 식으로 구조를 단순화하기로 했다.)

This comes after the Korea Expressway Retiree Association (KERA) was found to be monopolizing rest area operations, with KEC passing along bidding information, revealing cartel abuses. According to a Ministry investigation, KERA operated rest areas through subsidiaries, collecting commissions of up to 33% of sales from concessionaires, while KEC provided preferential treatment by sharing rest area bidding information with KERA. (이는 도공 퇴직자 단체(도성회)가 휴게소를 독점 운영하고, 도공은 입찰 정보를 넘기는 등 카르텔 병폐가 드러났기 때문이다. 도성회는 자회사를 통해 휴게소를 운영하면서 입점업체로부터 매출액의 33%에 달하는 수수료를 받아 챙겼고, 도공은 도성회에 휴게소 입찰 정보를 넘겨주는 등 특혜를 준 것으로 국토부 조사에서 드러난 바 있다.)

The Ministry stated that transitioning to the public management company system will lower rental fees to around 8-9% of sales. Lower rental fees are expected to improve long-standing issues in rest areas, such as high food prices and poor service quality. Additionally, to ensure fairness, bids for concessionaires will undergo evaluation by an external review committee, and current KEC employees, retirees within three years, and their immediate family members will be excluded from bidding. The public management company is scheduled to be established early next year. Second Vice Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Hong Ji-sun said, "By next year, up to 100 of the 200 rest areas will be operated by the public management company," adding, "We will appoint someone with private sector expertise or knowledge as CEO, excluding those from KEC backgrounds." (국토부는 공공관리 회사 체제로 전환하면 임대료가 매출액의 8~9% 수준으로 낮아질 거라고 밝혔다. 임대료가 낮아지면 휴게소의 고질적인 문제로 지적돼온 비싼 음식값과 부실한 서비스 문제도 개선될 수 있다고 보고 있다. 아울러 입점업체 입찰 시에는 외부심사위원회 평가를 거쳐 공정성을 확보하고, 도공 현직자·3년 이내 퇴직자 및 직계가족은 입찰에서 배제하기로 했다. 공공관리 회사는 내년 초 설립될 예정이다. 홍지선 국토부 2차관은 “내년 중 휴게소 200곳 중 100곳까지는 공공관리회사에서 운영할 예정”이라며 “민간에서 노하우나 전문지식이 있는 분을 최고경영자로 하는 등 도공 출신은 배제할 것”이라고 말했다.)

The Ministry plans to begin the reorganization with eight rest areas (Hapcheon Lake northbound and southbound, Wolchulsan, Yeoju, Gunwi, Jangyu, Daecheon northbound and southbound) that are newly established or have expiring contracts this year. Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Kim Yoon-deok stated, "Due to the decades-long entrenchment of unreasonable structures in rest areas, people had to endure the inconvenience of high prices and poor service," adding, "Starting with the eight rest areas opening this year, we will boldly dismantle these irrational structures and replace them solely with public benefits, returning the rest areas to the people." (국토부는 올해 신설 및 계약 종료되는 휴게소 8곳(합천호 상·하행, 월출산, 여주, 군위, 장유, 대천 상·하행)부터 개편한다는 방침이다. 김윤덕 국토부 장관은 “휴게소의 수십 년간 굳어진 불합리한 구조 탓에 비싼 가격과 아쉬운 서비스라는 불편을 감내해야만 했다”며 “연내 개장하는 8개 휴게소를 시작으로 불합리한 구조는 과감히 혁파하고 그 자리에 오직 국민의 편익만 채워 휴게소를 국민의 품으로 다시 돌려드리겠다”고 말했다.)

item.title: ‘JTBC·JoongAng Ilbo Bonds’ Victims: At Least 280 People, 30 Billion Won… Attorney ‘Lee Bok-hyun’ Takes on the Case (‘JTBC·중앙일보 채권’ 피해 최소 280명·300억…수임 ‘이복현 변호사’)
item.description:
At least 300 individual investors are estimated to have been harmed by corporate bonds and electronic short-term bonds issued by JTBC and JoongAng Ilbo, with damages amounting to at least 30 billion won. <<> Lee Bok-hyun Law Office and law firm Changcheon announced on the 9th that they had formed a ‘Joint Legal Team for Damage Relief from JoongAng Group Bonds’ to represent individual investors who suffered losses due to the default of the JoongAng Group (including its affiliates JTBC and JoongAng Ilbo). The legal team stated that they have been entrusted by 286 victims so far, with the total entrusted bond damages exceeding 30 billion won. Recently, JTBC filed for corporate rehabilitation (court receivership) with the Seoul Bankruptcy Court, while JoongAng Ilbo applied for a workout (corporate financial restructuring plan) with its creditor group. <<> The legal team explained, “Most victims are ordinary citizens who sought to cover medical expenses, living costs, or plan for retirement with interest rates slightly better than bank rates. Their hard-earned money was used to plug the cash flow gaps of a huge media corporation, resulting in massive property losses.” They added that a financially troubled company, with a debt ratio exceeding 2,600% and in a state of capital erosion, sold bonds to individuals just five days before applying for corporate rehabilitation. Individual investors, trapped in an ‘information asymmetry’ where they could not know the company’s exact financial status, relied on trust in financial institutions (banks, securities firms) responsible for issuing, selling, and distributing the bonds, and invested their hard-earned money. <<> The legal team pointed out, “During this process, securities firms earned hundreds of millions of won in profits each time they managed the issuance and sale,” and urged the Financial Supervisory Service to conduct strict inspections on Shinhan Investment Corp., which managed and underwrote the bond issuance; Kiwoom Securities, which sold the short-term bonds; and investment advisory firms and other securities firms involved in selling and brokering the bonds. The team argued that a significant portion of the issued bonds were formally allocated to institutions but effectively sold to individuals, and it is impossible that the lead underwriters were unaware of this structure where bonds were primarily taken up by individuals. <<> Attorney Lee Bok-hyun, who leads the legal team, previously served as the head of the Financial Supervisory Service during the Yoon Suk-yeol administration. <<> Jo Gye-wan, Senior Reporter kyewan@hani.co.kr (제이티비시(JTBC)·중앙일보가 발행한 회사채∙전자단기사채에 투자한 개인 피해자가 최소 300여명, 피해액은 최소 300억원에 이르는 것으로 추정된다.)

item.title: Industry on alert as Middle East tensions rise… closely watching oil prices and logistics variables (중동 긴장 고조에 산업계 촉각…유가·물류 변수 예의주시)
item.description:
With armed clashes between the United States and Iran escalating tensions around the Strait of Hormuz again, domestic industries are closely monitoring the situation. While the immediate impact has not yet materialized into a full-blown crisis, the growing uncertainty has created an atmosphere of unease. (미국과 이란의 무력 충돌이 발생하며 호르무즈해협을 둘러싼 긴장이 다시 고조되자 국내 산업계도 상황을 예의주시하고 있다. 당장 충격이 현실화하는 상황은 아니지만, 불확실성이 커진 만큼 긴장감이 감도는 분위기다.)

On the 8th (local time), September-delivery Brent crude and August-delivery West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures closed at $78.02 per barrel and $73.52 per barrel, rising by 5.20% and 4.37%, respectively. These are the highest levels since June 19 and June 22, respectively. (8일(현지시각) 9월 인도분 브렌트유와 8월 인도분 미국 서부 텍사스산 원유(WTI) 선물은 각각 5.20%, 4.37% 오른 배럴당 78.02달러, 73.52달러에 거래를 마쳤다. 각각 지난 6월19일, 6월22일 이후 최고치다.)

According to a summary of industry accounts on the 9th, the aviation sector is the most sensitive to the Middle East situation. If international oil prices surge again, it could lead to increases in fuel surcharges after a time lag, and if this coincides with the peak summer vacation season, it could heighten the burden of rising operating costs and worsening profitability. There are also concerns that a sustained period of high oil prices could dampen demand for long-haul routes. An aviation industry official said, "If tensions escalate, demand could shift again to medium- and short-haul routes like Japan and China, while long-haul demand could shrink." However, he added, "Because we've experienced this before, the market impact might be slightly less severe than in the second quarter." (9일 산업계 설명을 종합하면, 중동 정세에 가장 민감한 곳은 항공업계다. 국제유가가 다시 급등할 경우 시차를 두고 유류할증료 인상으로 이어질 수 있고, 여름 휴가철 성수기 진입 시점과 맞물리면 영업비용 증가와 수익성 악화 부담이 커질 수 있어서다. 고유가 기조가 지속되면 장거리 노선의 수요 위축으로 이어질 수 있다는 지적도 나온다. 한 항공업계 관계자는 “긴장 고조 땐 다시 일본과 중국 등 중·단거리에 수요가 몰리고, 장거리는 수요 위축이 우려된다”고 말했다. 다만 “앞서 경험이 있었기 때문에 시장에 미치는 충격은 지난 2분기보다는 조금 덜 할 것 같다”고 덧붙였다.)

The shipping industry is worried that a recent recovery driven by increased cargo volumes could face setbacks. A shipping industry official said, "Freight rates were already rising due to demand to ship existing cargo quickly, but if international oil prices go up again, shipping companies will face higher cost burdens, inevitably slowing the improvement in earnings from rate increases." (해운업계는 최근 물동량 증가로 회복세를 타던 시장에 악재가 닥칠까 우려하고 있다. 한 해운업계 관계자는 “기존 물동량들을 빠르게 실어 보내려는 수요 때문에 운임이 상승하고 있었는데, 국제 유가가 다시 올라가면 해운사 입장에서는 원가 부담이 커져 운임 상승에 따른 실적 개선이 둔화할 수밖에 없을 것”이라고 했다.)

The cosmetics industry is operating a flexible response system, including preparing to switch to air freight in case of disruptions in maritime transport. A cosmetics industry official said, "Given the persistent uncertainty in the regional situation, we are closely monitoring changes and have a system in place to immediately adjust cargo allocation and transport routes if necessary." The food industry is also wary of volatility from the unstable Middle East situation. If the costs of importing raw materials and materials and maritime logistics costs spike simultaneously, cost pressures could increase, making it difficult to be optimistic about overall third-quarter earnings recovery. (화장품업계는 해상 운송 차질에 대비해 항공 물량으로 전환 가능성을 열어두는 등 유연한 대응 체계를 가동하고 있다. 화장품업계 관계자는 “지역 정세의 불확실성이 상존하는 만큼, 상황 변화를 면밀히 살피면서 필요시 물량 배분과 운송 경로를 즉시 조정할 수 있는 체계를 갖추고 운영 중”이라고 말했다. 식품업계 역시 중동 정세 불안에 따른 변동성을 경계하고 있다. 원부자재 수입 비용과 해상 물류비가 동시에 치솟을 경우 원가 압박이 커질 수 있어, 전반적인 3분기 실적 회복을 낙관하기 어렵다는 것이다.)

For now, the prevailing view is that it is too early to predict immediate damage from supply chain paralysis or a full-scale war. An aviation industry official said, "At this point, there's not much we can do other than watch the situation. Even if fuel costs rise, aside from limited measures similar to past crises—like reducing some non-profitable routes—it's hard to find viable countermeasures." (현재로써는 공급망 마비나 전면전으로 인한 즉각적인 타격을 단정하기는 이르다는 게 중론이다. 한 항공업계 관계자는 “현재로서는 상황을 지켜보는 것 외에 뾰족한 수가 없다며, 유류비가 오르더라도 비수익 노선을 일부 감편하는 등 과거 위기 때와 유사한 제한적 대응 체계 외에는 마땅한 대책을 찾기 어려운 실정”이라고 전했다.)

Reporter Lee Ju-bin yes@hani.co.kr (이주빈 기자 yes@hani.co.kr)

item.title: KDI: "By 2030, Over 90% of Jobs Could See 90% of Tasks Replaced" (KDI “2030년 일자리 90% 이상에서 업무 90% 대체 가능”)
item.description:
The state-run Korea Development Institute (KDI) has projected that by 2030, more than 90% of current jobs will have over 90% of their tasks technically automatable due to the introduction of artificial intelligence (AI) and other technologies. This forecast also underpins the government's decision to operate the "Korean-style Canary Dashboard," which illustrates changes in the labor market driven by AI advancements. (국책연구기관인 한국개발연구원(KDI)이 인공지능(AI) 등의 도입으로 2030년엔 현재 일자리의 90% 이상에서 90% 이상 업무의 기술적 자동화가 가능하다는 전망을 내놨다. 정부가 인공지능 발전에 따른 노동시장 변화를 보여주는 ‘한국형 카나리아 대시보드’를 운영하기로 한 배경이기도 하다.)

KDI Research Fellow Han Yoseop made these remarks on the 9th at a forum titled "The Future of Work: A New Labor Market Coexisting with AI," co-hosted by the Ministry of Economy and Finance and the institute at the Korea Federation of Banks in Seoul. He explained that discussions, both domestically and internationally, are intensifying regarding the potential for AI technology to reduce youth employment, and noted that employment prospects vary significantly depending on the direction of corporate AI transformation (AX) and the ability to create new jobs. ( 한요셉 케이디아이 연구위원은 9일 재정경제부와 연구원이 서울 은행회관에서 주최한 ‘일의 미래: 에이아이와 공존하는 새로운 노동시장’ 포럼에서 이처럼 밝혔다. 그는 국내외에서 인공지능 기술이 청년 일자리를 감소시킬 수 있다는 논의가 활발해졌다고 설명하며, 향후 기업의 인공지능 전환(AX) 전개 방향과 새로운 직무 창출 능력에 따라 고용 전망에 큰 차이가 있다고 짚었다. )

Han stressed, "In this situation, new labor demand must be created quickly to achieve net job creation," adding, "We need to enhance organizational flexibility to facilitate moves into new roles and boost the creation of new jobs and occupations by revitalizing the startup ecosystem." ( 한 연구위원은 “이런 상황에서 새로운 노동수요가 빠르게 창출될 수 있어야 순고용 창출이 가능하다”며 “조직내 유연성을 높여 새 직무로의 이동을 촉진하고, 창업 생태계 활성화로 신직무·신직업 창출력을 제고해야 한다”고 말했다.)

Indeed, major global institutions are issuing a series of reports warning of the repercussions of AI-driven employment reduction. Earlier, the International Labour Organization predicted that 25% of global employment is exposed to AI, with the impact likely more severe in high-income countries, where 34% of jobs are exposed to AI. McKinsey also projected in a 2023 report that 50% of all tasks could be automated between 2030 and 2060. ( 실제 세계 주요 기관에서는 인공지능으로 인한 고용 축소 여파를 경계하는 보고서가 잇따르고 있다. 앞서 국제노동기구는 지난해 전세계 고용의 25%가 인공지능에 노출돼 있으며, 특히 고소득국가 고용의 34%가 인공지능에 노출돼 여파가 더 클 것으로 전망한 바 있다. 맥킨지도 2023년 보고서에서 2030~2060년 사이 전체 업무의 50%가 자동화될 수 있다고 내다봤다.)

There are also calls for a redesign of distribution, governance, and capacity development, given that the employment shock from AI is hitting the younger generation first. Jang Ji-yeon, a senior research fellow at the Korea Labor Institute, noted, "While productivity gains enlarge the pie, polarization is also deepening in an asymmetrical situation," and emphasized, "We need to diversify the foundation for securing resources, such as by clawing back excessive AI profits through mechanisms like a sovereign wealth fund." ( 인공지능 고용 충격이 청년 세대부터 발생한단 점에서 분배·거버넌스, 역량 개발까지 재설계해야 한다는 지적도 나왔다. 장지연 한국노동연구원 선임연구위원은 “생산성 향상으로 파이가 커지지만 양극화도 심화되고 있는 비대칭적 상황”이라며 “에이아이 초과이윤 환수(국부펀드 장치 등) 방안 등 재원 마련의 토대를 다변화해야 한다”고 짚었다. )

Furthermore, suggestions were made to involve young people as decision-makers, not just for token consultation, in social issues that are difficult to resolve at the corporate level. Additionally, government support, which currently focuses on school- and training institution-centered education, should be expanded to include online and workplace learning, taking into account those outside the formal system and rapidly changing technologies. ( 아울러 기업 단위로 풀기 어려운 사회적 의제에 청년을 형식적 자문이 아닌 의사결정 주체로 참여시키고, 학교나 훈련기관 중심 교육에 집중된 정부 지원방식 역시 제도권 밖의 이들과 빠르게 변화하는 기술을 고려해 온라인 및 일터 학습까지 지원 대상으로 삼아야 한다는 제언도 내놨다.)

By Park Su-ji, Reporter suji@hani.co.kr ( 박수지 기자 suji@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Guri and Giheung See Surge in Last-Minute Buying Demand: Apartment Price Increases Expand Before and After Designation as Regulated Areas (구리·기흥 등 막판 매수 수요 몰렸다…규제지역 지정 전후 아파트값 상승폭 확대)
item.description:
On June 30, Hwaseong Dongtan, Guri, and Yongin Giheung-gu were designated as regulated areas, but the apartment prices in Guri and Giheung expanded further. This appears to be due to a surge in last-moment gap investment demand before the areas were placed under land transaction permit zones. (지난달 30일 화성 동탄·구리·용인 기흥구가 규제지역으로 지정됐지만 구리와 기흥의 아파트값은 상승폭이 더 확대됐다. 토지거래허가구역으로 묶이기 전에 막판 갭투자 수요가 몰린 영향으로 보인다.)

According to the 'Weekly Apartment Price Trends' released by the Korea Real Estate Board on the 9th, based on a survey conducted on the 6th of this month, apartment sales prices in Guri City rose by 0.64% in the first week of July compared to the previous week, widening the increase from the week just before the regulated area designation (0.30%). In Yongin Giheung-gu, prices also rose by 0.56% in this week's survey, significantly exceeding the previous week's increase of 0.39%. However, in Hwaseong Dongtan-gu, the increase slowed to 1.29% from 1.46% the previous week. ( 9일 한국부동산원이 발표한 ‘주간 아파트값 동향’을 보면, 이달 6일 조사 기준 7월 첫 주 구리시 아파트 매맷값은 지난주 대비 0.64% 상승해 규제지역 지정 직전 주(0.30%)에 비해 상승폭이 커졌다. 용인 기흥구도 이번주 조사에서 0.56% 올라 지난주(0.39%) 상승폭을 크게 웃돌았다. 다만 화성 동탄구는 1.29%로 지난주(1.46%)보다 상승 폭이 줄었다.)

The real estate industry views that, although these three areas were designated as adjustment target areas and speculative overheating districts effective June 30, the land transaction permit zones only took effect on the 5th of this month, leading to increased last-minute gap investment demand before the permit restrictions and driving up prices. Dongtan, which recorded the highest cumulative increase in apartment sales prices nationwide in the first half of the year (14.46%), appears to have entered a cooling-off period after peaking around the time of the regulated area designation. ( 부동산 업계에서는 지난달 30일자로 이들 3곳이 조정대상지역, 투기과열지구로 묶였지만 토지거래허가구역의 효력은 이달 5일부터 발효되면서 허가구역으로 묶이기 전에 막판 갭투자 수요가 늘며 가격이 뛴 것으로 보고 있다. 상반기 아파트 매매가격 누적 상승 폭이 전국 최고인 동탄(14.46%)은 규제지역 지정을 전후로 고점을 지나며 숨고르기에 들어간 것으로 보인다.)

The balloon effect in non-regulated areas also continued. In Namyangju City, the increase widened from 0.16% in the previous week's survey to 0.21% this week, and in Suwon Gwonseon-gu, the rise expanded from 0.25% last week to 0.26% this week. The price increase trend in existing regulated areas also persisted. Gwangmyeong City saw its increase rise from 0.38% to 0.44%, and Seongnam Bundang-gu saw a rise from 0.41% to 0.48%. ( 비규제지역의 풍선효과도 이어졌다. 남양주시는 지난주 조사 기준 0.16%에서 이번주 0.21%로 상승폭이 커졌고, 수원 권선구도 지난주 0.25%에서 이번주 0.26%로 오름폭이 확대됐다. 기존 규제지역의 가격 상승세도 지속됐다. 광명시는 지난주 0.38%에서 이번주 0.44%로, 성남 분당구는 0.41%에서 0.48%로 상승폭이 커졌다.)

Seoul apartment sale prices saw their increase expand from 0.27% last week to 0.30% this week. Districts such as Seongbuk (0.51%), Guro (0.50%), Jungnang (0.39%), Gwangjin (0.38%), and Nowon, Songpa, and Gangdong (0.34%) saw larger increases than last week. Jeonse (long-term rental deposit) prices in Seoul remained similar at 0.31% compared to last week's 0.30%. The Korea Real Estate Board explained that jeonse demand is continuing, mainly in areas near subway stations, school zones, and large apartment complexes. item.title: Butterfly Effect of Semiconductor Bonuses... Major Conglomerate SI Companies Establishing Unions One After Another (반도체 성과급 ‘나비효과’…대기업 SI, 잇따라 노조 설립)
item.description:
Labor unions are being established one after another at system integration (SI) companies affiliated with major domestic conglomerates such as Samsung and Hyundai Motor. Unlike the Pangyo IT industry, which saw a boom in union formation when the 52-hour workweek cap was introduced, the relatively quiet IT affiliates of the top four conglomerates are now seeing union organization pick up pace, triggered by the Samsung Electronics bonus issue. (삼성·현대차 등 국내 대기업 계열 시스템통합(SI) 기업에서 노동조합이 잇따라 설립되고 있다. 주 52시간 노동 상한제 도입 당시 노조 설립 붐이 일었던 판교 아이티(IT) 업계와 달리 비교적 조용했던 4대 그룹 아이티 계열사에서도 삼성전자 성과급 사태를 계기로 노조 조직화가 본격화하는 모습이다.)

On the 6th, a union affiliated with Samsung Group's enterprise-level union was launched as the Samsung SDS Union, and on the 9th, it announced that over 6,000 employees had applied for membership over three days. This exceeds half of the total workforce of 11,287 employees (as of the end of last year). Previously, the union submitted a collective bargaining request to the company on the 7th, and the company has also announced the bargaining request. This marks the first union since the company's founding in 1985. <<> The trigger for the union's formation was the company's push to reform its bonus system. The company proposed abolishing the existing cash-based Target Incentive (PI) and replacing it with a plan to grant 20% of annual salary in company stock, reflecting factors such as the year-on-year increase in pre-tax profit and stock price returns. However, this sparked backlash from employees due to concerns that bonuses would be heavily influenced by external variables like stock prices. <<> Hyundai AutoEver, an SI affiliate of Hyundai Motor Group, also formalized the launch of a labor union through a company-wide notice on the 8th. The Hyundai AutoEver union, established as a branch under the Korean Confederation of Trade Unions' National Chemical, Textile, Food, and Pharmaceutical Workers' Union, which also includes unions from Naver and Kakao, has completed the formation of a preparatory committee and is gearing up for the election of executive officers. Accumulated dissatisfaction with bonus calculation standards and performance evaluation methods is cited as the background for the union's formation. <<> Industry observers see the payment of bonuses worth hundreds of millions of won at SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics in the first half of this year as a catalyst that spread consensus among IT affiliates of large conglomerates on the need for union establishment. As the gap in bonuses widens across industries and companies within conglomerates, there is a growing movement to address grievances regarding evaluation and compensation systems through labor-management negotiations. <<> Reporter Seon Dam-eun sun@hani.co.kr ( 지난 6일 삼성그룹 초기업노조 산하 지부로 출범한 삼성에스디에스(SDS) 노조는 사흘간 6000명이 넘는 직원이 가입을 신청했다고 9일 밝혔다. 전체 직원 수(1만1287명·지난해 말 기준)의 과반이 넘는 규모다. 앞서 노조는 7일 회사에 단체교섭 요구서를 제출했으며, 회사도 교섭요구사실을 공고한 상태다. 이 회사에 노조가 생긴 건 1985년 창사 이래 처음이다.)

item.title: Retail investors net bought 5 trillion won in 15 days, 30% evaporated... 'Samsung Electronics-SK Hynix leverage' traps individual investors (보름간 5조 순매수, 30% 증발…‘삼전닉스 레버리지’에 물린 개미들)
item.description:
Since the KOSPI broke through 9100 and then plunged 9.99% on the 23rd of last month, marking the start of a 15-day downtrend, the frenzy over individual single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) by retail investors has intensified. Despite the underlying assets—Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix—continuously falling in price, buying pressure paradoxically surged, extending the trend. (코스피 9100 돌파 직후 9.99% 폭락하며 보름 동안의 하락장 시작을 알렸던 지난달 23일부터 개인의 단일종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF) 열풍은 더욱 거세진 것으로 나타났다. 기초자산인 삼성전자와 에스케이(SK)하이닉스의 주가가 연일 떨어지고 있는데 오히려 매수세가 몰리는 장세가 이어졌다.)

According to data from the Korea Exchange on the 9th, from the 23rd of last month to the previous day (12 trading days), retail investors' net purchases of 14 single-stock leveraged ETFs totaled 5.1919 trillion won. This period, which included events dubbed "Black Tuesday" (June 23 and July 7) and "Black Friday" (June 26), saw three instances of circuit breakers triggered by intraday drops exceeding 8%. Compared to the net purchase amount of 2.1337 trillion won by retail investors from the 5th to the 22nd of last month (also 12 trading days), the figure more than doubled. (9일 한국거래소 자료를 보면, 지난달 23일부터 전날까지(12거래일) 단일종목 레버리지 이티에프 14종의 개인 순매수 규모는 5조1919억원으로 나타났다. 이 기간에는 ‘검은 화요일’(6월23일, 7월7일)과 ‘검은 금요일’(6월26일)로 불리며 하루 장중 8% 이상 떨어져 서킷브레이커가 발동하는 폭락장이 3번 반복됐던 기간이다. 지난달 5∼22일(12거래일) 개인의 순매수 규모(2조1337억원)와 비교해도 2배 이상 폭증했다.)

Despite retail investors pouring in 5 trillion won, the results were dismal. According to data from the Korea Securities Depository, if someone had invested in the 14 single-stock leveraged products on the 23rd of last month, the average return as of the previous day was -32.30%. For an investment of 10 million won, depending on the product, the assessed value could drop by as much as 5.91 million won. (개인이 5조원을 쏟아부었지만 성적표는 처참했다. 한국예탁결제원 자료를 보면, 지난달 23일 단일종목 레버리지 상품 14종에 투자했을 때 전날 기준 수익률은 평균 -32.30%였다. 만일 1000만원을 투자했다면 상품에 따라서는 평가금액이 최대 591만원까지도 떨어진다.)

The average return on Samsung Electronics leveraged products was -24.26%, more than double the decline of the underlying stock's return of -10.48% over the same period. Similarly, the average return on SK Hynix leveraged products was -40.33%, more than double the underlying stock's return of -18.75%, resulting in significant losses. During this period, while foreign investors offloaded profit-taking sell orders and continued "selling at highs," retail investors engaged in "betting at highs," leading to a sharp drop in returns. (삼성전자 레버리지 상품의 평균 수익률은 -24.26%로 같은 기간 본주의 수익률인 -10.48%보다 2배 이상 하락했고, 에스케이하이닉스 레버리지의 평균 수익률은 40.33%로 본주의 수익률인 -18.75%보다 역시 2배 이상 떨어지며 손실을 봤다. 이 기간 외국인들이 차익실현 매물을 쏟아내며 ‘고점 매도’를 이어가는 동안 개인은 ‘고점 베팅’으로 수익률이 뚝 떨어진 셈이다.)

Investors suffering losses far outnumbered those making gains. According to an analysis by Korea Investment & Securities of the proportion of profitable and loss-making investors based on client accounts, among the 13,000 investors holding the KODEX SK Hynix leveraged product—the one with the largest net asset value (AUM)—100% were incurring losses as of the previous day. (수익보다는 손실을 본 투자자들이 압도적으로 많았다. 한국투자증권이 고객 계좌를 바탕으로 분석한 수익·손실투자자 비중을 보면, 순자산총액(AUM)이 가장 큰 코덱스(KODEX)의 에스케이하이닉스 레버리지 상품을 전날 기준으로 소유한 투자자 1만3천명 중 100%가 손실을 보고 있었다.)

The KODEX Samsung Electronics leveraged product also saw 99% of its 9,998 investors facing losses. Other products, such as those from TIGER with the next largest net asset values, showed similar loss-investor ratios. Kim Seok-hwan, a researcher at Mirae Asset Securities, noted, "Individual investors are continuing to buy in hopes of recovering their paper losses." (코덱스의 삼성전자 레버리지 상품도 투자자 9998명 중 99%가 손실을 봤다. 순자산총액이 그다음으로 큰 타이거(TIGER) 등 상품도 비슷한 손실투자자 비중을 보였다. 김석환 미래에셋증권 연구원은 “개인 투자자들이 평가 손실 회복을 위한 매수를 지속하고 있다”고 봤다.)

Amid extreme volatility, even securities firms are advising against leveraged investments. Noh Dong-gil, a researcher at Shinhan Investment Securities, said, "As of the 6th, the credit balances for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix had increased by 13% and 19%, respectively, compared to June 22. Even with price declines, leverage hasn't decreased. What's needed now is a strategy to reduce leverage to manage volatility while maintaining core spot holdings." (극심한 변동성 장세에서는 증권사마저 레버리지 투자를 줄일 것을 권고하고 있다. 노동길 신한투자증권 연구원은 “지난 6일까지도 삼성전자와 에스케이하이닉스 신용잔고는 6월22일 대비 각각 13%, 19% 늘었다. 가격 하락에도 레버리지가 감소하지 않은 것”이라며 “지금 필요한 것은 변동성을 감당하도록 레버리지를 축소하고, 현물 코어(핵심)는 유지하는 전략”이라고 제안했다.)

Meanwhile, concerns are growing that single-stock leveraged products are amplifying the KOSPI's decline and deepening retail investor losses, prompting sharp criticism from securities firms. Yuanta Securities released a report titled "Why Korea Alone Sees Sharp Swings Everyone Knows—When Will Improvement Come?" which stated, "The reason for Korea's sharp drop on the previous day amid Asian stock markets is the single-stock leveraged products, which dominate retail investor net buying and top KOSPI trading volumes. Since retail investors' buying capacity cannot expand indefinitely, institutional improvements are urgently needed to reduce volatility." (한편 단일종목 레버리지 상품으로 인해 코스피 낙폭이 더욱 커지고, 개인 손실이 확대되는 데 우려가 커지는 상황에서 증권사의 쓴소리도 나왔다. 유안타증권은 전날 ‘모두가 아는 한국만 급등락하는 이유, 개선은 언제?’라는 제목의 보고서를 내어 “(전날 기준) 아시아 주식시장 내 한국만 급락한 원인은 단일종목 레버리지 상품으로, 개인 투자자 순매수 및 코스피 거래대금 최상위권에 포진하고 있다”며 “개인의 순매수 여력이 무한정 확장될 수는 없기 때문에 변동성 축소를 위해 제도 개선이 시급하다”고 제언했다.)

On this day, the KOSPI fluctuated within the day before closing at 7291.91, up 0.62% from the previous day. The lowest point was 7063.76, and the highest was 7543.86, a difference of over 500 points. (이날도 코스피는 장중 등락을 반복하다가 전날보다 0.62% 오른 7291.91에 마감했다. 최저점은 7063.76이고, 최고점은 7543.86으로 500포인트 이상 차이가 났다.)

Reporter Kim Ga-yoon gayoon@hani.co.kr (김가윤 기자 gayoon@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Preemptive Block on Speculation"... Honam Semiconductor Industrial Complex Site Designated as Land Transaction Permit Zone (“투기 선제 차단”…호남 반도체 산단 예정지, 토지거래허가구역 지정)
item.description:
The site of the Gwangju Air Force Base and surrounding areas, which are the planned locations for the Honam Semiconductor Advanced National Industrial Complex, have been designated as a land transaction permit zone. (호남 반도체 첨단국가산단 사업 예정지인 광주 군공항 부지와 인근 지역이 토지거래허가구역으로 지정됐다.)

The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (MOLIT) and the South Jeolla-Gwangju Special Metropolitan City announced on the 9th that, following deliberation by the Central Urban Planning Committee, a total of 364.19 square kilometers in the area of the planned Honam semiconductor industrial complex will be designated as a land transaction permit zone for two years. The affected areas include Dong-gu, Seo-gu, Nam-gu, Buk-gu, and Gwangsan-gu of the South Jeolla-Gwangju Special Metropolitan City, as well as Naju-si, Jangseong-gun, and Hwasun-gun. The designation takes effect from the 14th and lasts until July 13, 2028. This land transaction permit zone was determined based on the legal administrative district (dong/ri) boundaries of the planned Honam Semiconductor Advanced National Industrial Complex site and surrounding areas. <<> Since the Gwangju Air Force Base was selected on the 6th as the site for the Honam semiconductor cluster project, one of the government's three mega projects, concerns have been raised about the influx of speculative demand driven by development expectations. MOLIT pushed forward the procedure for designating the land transaction permit zone to preemptively curb land price increases and speculative transactions. Transactions of land within the land transaction permit zone require prior approval, and a mandatory actual-use requirement within five years is imposed. Violations may result in enforcement orders and imposition of enforcement fines. <<> MOLIT and the South Jeolla-Gwangju Special Metropolitan City stated, "We plan to intensively monitor the newly designated land transaction permit zone and, if any suspicious illegal activities such as abnormal transactions or speculative acts are identified, we will respond sternly in cooperation with relevant agencies." <<> Reporter Lee Ji-hye godot@hani.co.kr (국토교통부와 전남광주통합특별시는 9일 중앙도시계획위원회 심의를 거쳐 호남권 반도체 산단 조성사업 예정지 일원 총 364.19㎢를 2년간 토지거래허가구역으로 지정한다고 밝혔다. 대상 지역은 전남광주통합특별시 동구·서구·남구·북구·광산구와 나주시, 장성군, 화순군이다. 오는 14일부터 효력이 발생하며 지정 기간은 2028년 7월13일까지다. 이번 토지거래허가구역은 호남 반도체 첨단국가산단 조성 예정지와 인근 지역의 법정동·리 경계선을 기준으로 확정됐다.)

item.title: Jo In-ho, CEO of Haegwang E&C, Receives Gold Tower Industrial Order of Merit at '2026 Construction Day' (‘2026 건설의 날’ 금탑산업훈장에 조인호 해광이엔씨 대표)
item.description:
The '2026 Construction Day' ceremony was held on the 9th at the Construction Hall in Nonhyeon-dong, Gangnam-gu, Seoul. (‘2026 건설의 날’ 기념식이 9일 서울 강남구 논현동 건설회관에서 열렸다.)

Hosted by the Construction Association of Korea, the ceremony took place under the theme 'K-Construction Building the Future,' reflecting a commitment to leap forward as a future industry by establishing an AI foundation and expanding technology adoption in the era of AI convergence. (대한건설단체총연합회가 주최한 기념식은 인공지능(AI) 융합 시대에 건설산업 역시 인공지능 기반 구축과 기술 도입을 확산해 미래산업으로 도약한다는 다짐을 담아 ‘미래를 짓는 케이(K)-건설’을 주제로 진행됐다.)

The ceremony was attended by approximately 500 people, including Prime Minister Han Seok-soo, Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Kim Yoon-deok, government officials, lawmakers, heads of construction-related organizations, government award recipients, and their families. About 100 high school and university students from construction-related fields across the country also participated. (기념식에는 한성숙 국무총리, 김윤덕 국토교통부 장관 등 정부 관료와 국회의원, 건설 관련 단체장, 정부 포상 수상자와 가족 등 500여명이 참석했다. 전국의 건설 관련 고교생과 대학생 100여명도 자리를 함께 했다.)

This year, 107 awards were presented to individuals who contributed to the development of the construction industry. The Gold Tower Industrial Order of Merit was awarded to Jo In-ho, CEO of Haegwang E&C, for successfully carrying out major national projects over 40 years and contributing to the development of the mechanical equipment sector. The Silver Tower Industrial Order of Merit was given to Choi Sang-dae, CEO of Daedo Construction, and Choi Gil-hak, CEO of Seorim General Construction, while the Bronze Tower Industrial Order of Merit was awarded to Jang Heung-soo, CEO of Youngshin General Construction, and Lee Sa-cheol, CEO of Seonjin A&F. <<> Prime Minister Han Seok-soo said in a congratulatory speech, "The government will actively support the construction industry, which accounts for over 10% of GDP, in overcoming low growth and leaping forward as a future growth industry," and urged, "Please strive to expand housing supply, spread smart construction technology, and strengthen overseas construction competitiveness." (올해는 건설산업 발전 유공자들에게 107점의 포상이 수여됐다. 금탑산업훈장은 40년간 주요 국책사업을 성공적으로 수행하고 기계설비 분야 발전에 기여한 조인호 해광이엔씨 대표가 수상했다. 은탑산업훈장은 최상대 대도토건 대표와 서림종합건설 최길학 대표에게, 동탑산업훈장은 장흥수 영신종합건설 대표와 이사철 선진에이엔에프 대표에게 돌아갔다.)

Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Kim Yoon-deok stated, "We will create safer construction sites by expanding AI-based smart safety management and prevention-centered safety systems," and added, "We will actively promote R&D investment and industrial ecosystem development tailored to each stage, including technology development, talent cultivation, industry promotion, and overseas expansion." (한성숙 국무총리는 축사를 통해 “국내총생산의 10% 이상을 담당하는 건설삽업이 저성장을 극복하고 미래 성장산업으로 도약할 수 있도록 정부가 적극 지원하겠다”면서 “주택공급 확대와 스마트 건설기술 확산, 해외건설 경쟁력 강화에 힘써달라”고 당부했다.)

Senior Reporter Choi Jong-hoon cjhoon@hani.co.kr (김윤덕 국토부 장관은 “인공지능 기반 스마트 안전관리와 예방 중심 안전체계를 확대해 더욱 안전한 건설현장을 만들겠다”며 “기술 개발과 인재 양성, 산업 육성, 해외 진출 등 각 단계에 맞는 연구개발 투자와 산업 생태계 조성을 적극 추진해 나가겠다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Korea Cyber University Development Fund 'KCU Dream' Accelerates Nurturing Future Talent (고려사이버대학교 발전기금 'KCU Dream'으로 미래 인재 양성 박차)
item.description:
Korea Cyber University announced that it is accelerating the cultivation of future talent by operating the Korea Cyber University Development Fund 'KCU Dream' to support the sustainable growth of the university and its students. (고려사이버대학교는 대학과 학생의 지속 가능한 성장을 지원하기 위한 고려사이버대학교 발전기금 'KCU Dream'을 운영하며 미래 인재 양성에 박차를 가하고 있다고 밝혔다.)

'KCU Dream' is a fund established to improve the educational environment, provide scholarship support, and promote research at Korea Cyber University. It operates based on voluntary participation from university members, alumni, and general donors. Through this, the university is creating a virtuous cycle where students and the institution grow together under the premise of 'conveying hearts to challenges toward dreams.' <<> As of the first semester of the 2026 academic year, the cumulative size of the development fund has reached approximately 1.8 billion KRW, with about 182 donors including institutions and approximately 2,114 cumulative payment cases. This is regarded as a meaningful achievement, realizing both continuous development and social responsibility as a cyber university. <<> The fund is utilized in various areas, including educational environment improvement, scholarships, research, education, construction, departmental development, and social contribution. In particular, it focuses on scholarship support for students facing economic difficulties in continuing their studies and on enhancing learning infrastructure. <<> In addition, Korea Cyber University launched the 'KCU Dream Development Fund 1·1·1 Campaign' last April to spread a culture of giving. This campaign is a participatory program encouraging 'one person to donate 10,000 KRW per month for one year,' designed to allow anyone to participate in the university's development without burden through small regular donations. <<> Korea Cyber University President Won-gyu Lee stated, "Korea Cyber University is building a sustainable educational ecosystem based on the warm hearts of its members and donors," and added, "We will continue to create an environment where students can realize their dreams through the development fund, and leap forward as a prestigious cyber university representing South Korea." <<> Meanwhile, Korea Cyber University is accepting new and transfer students for the second semester of the 2026 academic year until July 15. Working professionals can receive a 50% tuition reduction benefit through an industry-commissioned agreement. Admission guidelines can be found on the admissions support center website or by calling the representative phone number. <<> <This article is an information article provided by the university and may differ from the opinion of The Hankyoreh> ('KCU Dream'은 고려사이버대학교의 교육 환경 개선과 장학 지원, 연구 활성화 등을 위해 조성된 기금으로, 대학 구성원과 동문, 일반 후원자들의 자발적인 참여를 바탕으로 운영되고 있다. 대학은 이를 통해 '꿈을 향한 도전에 마음을 전한다'는 취지 아래 학생과 학교가 함께 성장하는 선순환 구조를 만들어가고 있다.)
